title: Bind remote approvals to WebAuthn and existing ControlPlane receipts
head: 92f36f174c64423f9f2ad025b16b7ed163b10fbb
merge_note: Task 32 Memory surface (8a8c5c1) merged as real merge 92f36f1 with no conflicts. Security page and memory files both remain. Gates rerun on the merge result.

enrollment_origin_policy.citation: docs/personal-os/contracts.md remote approval table: principal absent -> active is local Linux ControlPlane owner enrollment only; remote self-enrollment has no authority
enrollment_origin_policy.gateway_behavior: The security page shows that enrollment is unavailable on the gateway origin and does not call the local enrollment route from that origin. Registration and approval ceremonies still submit server-issued options to Linux.

blockers.B1: early-phase rejections audit in their own transaction; expired challenges are marked terminal
blockers.B2: shipped security page calls navigator.credentials.create and navigator.credentials.get; credential list and revocation staging use the Linux API; the client does not mint or verify receipts
blockers.B3: compose loads the sealed decision signing key through readEd25519PrivateKeyFile; readiness is ready only on a matching key, otherwise signer_unconfigured, signer_unsealed, or signer_mismatch; the resolver looks up the staged ControlPlane request; the phone gateway proxies /api/v1/remote-approvals/*, registration ceremonies, credential reads, and /security

remediation_blockers.B3-R: FIXED: production /registrations/<ceremony_id>/verify resolved the ceremony id as an enrollment id and returned 401 REMOTE_SESSION_REQUIRED. remote-approval-ingress lookupStaged now branches on registrationFrom(path); verify looks up webauthn_registration_ceremonies_v2 by ceremony id and binds to its owning local enrollment_id + begin_request_id. Enrollment begin stays local-session only. Proven end-to-end enroll -> register verify -> approve through createPhoneGatewayServer with the production composer/resolver.
remediation_blockers.B2-R(a): FIXED: gateway served /security with no Vite manifest so manifest-listed asset serving denied every asset. dashboard/vite.config.ts enables build.manifest=manifest.json at dist/dashboard/manifest.json; a gateway test serves /security and its JS/CSS from a real dashboard build.
remediation_blockers.B2-R(b)-local: FIXED: same-origin GET has no Origin header so requireLocalSession returned 403 LOCAL_SESSION_REQUIRED. hasSameOriginReadOrigin (absent or exact-match Origin) now gates read GETs; mutation origin checks unchanged.
remediation_blockers.B2-R(b)-gateway: FIXED: security-client called /api/v1/session (404 on gateway) and omitted the phone CSRF token so listing returned 403 PHONE_CSRF_REQUIRED. security-client.ts now uses one shared jsonFetch/jsonPost path that always sets x-jarvis-csrf, fetching the token from /api/v1/phone/session on the gateway origin.
remediation_blockers.B3-R2: FIXED: forged, other-owner, expired, and replayed registration verify now each write one typed remote.% audit row in a committed transaction and add no credential. Expiry is committed outside the rejecting transaction, so an expired ceremony becomes terminal instead of rolling back to issued. Unknown ceremony id is included.
remediation_blockers.B5-R: FIXED: options issuance still refuses a staged request whose stored args no longer match its command digest. Verify of an existing challenge reaches the binding check, so an arg modified after options is 403 binding with one audit row and zero receipts.
remediation_blockers.cheap_notes: consistentRequest still recomputes controlCommandDigest when issuing options and when no challenge exists; up/uv recorded on the early-rejection audit when an assertion exists; compose distinguishes signerSource unconfigured|rejected|file so a rejected key file is not reported as signer_unconfigured.

refactor: src/remote-approval.ts crossed the 250 pure-LOC ceiling after recording up/uv; classifyReadiness plus SignerSource/RemoteReadiness/ReadinessInput extracted into new src/remote-approval-readiness.ts (31 LOC), bringing remote-approval.ts back under the ceiling.

gate_notes.audit_flags: rejection audits record authenticator up/uv bits when an assertion body is present; missing UV is uv=0
gate_notes.policy_ttl: challenge, registration, reservation, begin, and activation expiries read the parsed policy fields
gate_notes.prose_pins: removed the source-text pin in remote-approval-task36-receipts.test.ts
